label: Belenos system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Belenos locus represented by a VCA0457 profile that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Belenos branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual VCA0457 genes, VCA0457 proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one Belenos locus, unresolved Belenos trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
